title: Stepmom gave him three days; he came back in a supercar
description: Nate blows his stepmom's money on bad trades, gets three days to win it back and is thrown out when his balance hits zero. His best friend films his meltdown, they start making videos, switch to tokens people actually want on fomo, and after nights of grinding Nate's balance passes half a million and he pulls up in a supercar beside a woman who asks where he gets his wins. Unlike the mom-and-supercar-friend version, here the friend is a broke buddy on foot who films Nate, and Nate drives off alone with 'That's in my bio.'
text:
SCENE 1 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — EVENING
Nate's stepmom upends a black trash bag over his bed; hundreds of crumpled chart printouts and empty energy-drink cans avalanche out as Nate lunges for the pile.
STEPMOM: Nate! Where did all my money go? You spent it on these?
NATE: I was going to buy...
STEPMOM: Okay.
She snatches his phone off the bed and holds it up in his face.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone in her hand, the line sliding red
STEPMOM: You use my money for this?!
NATE: I'm trading this.
She swings the phone toward his wall of glowing monitors and taped-up charts.
STEPMOM: Your room looks like a trading floor.
NATE: Exactly. Okay... bad example.
She hoists the trash bag overhead, then jabs a finger at him by the door.
STEPMOM: Three days. Win it back, or you're out.
STEPMOM: Three days.
She presses the phone into his hand and walks out.
NATE: Mom-
SCENE 2 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — THREE DAYS
Nate plants his fists on the desk and glares at camera.
NATE: Fine.
Overhead: Nate dives onto the bed, sorting printouts into piles; his hands wipe his phone screen clean and tap into a trade.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, the line flat and red
NATE: Nothing. Okay.
NATE: Better charts.
Nate drags a second monitor onto the desk and draws lines across a chart, squinting.
STEPMOM (O.S.): How good... you did?
NATE: Nothing.
NATE: Buy...
Nate sits behind a fort of energy-drink cans, staring at his phone.
NATE: Soon.
Golden hour through the window: Nate checks his phone and deflates.
NATE: No, come on.
Nate begs his phone, eyebrows up, pouting.
NATE: One, just one.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, one small green candle
Nate leaps out of his chair, celebrating.
NATE: Yes, I can keep it.
The line plunges; Nate's grin freezes.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, the chart crashing to the floor
NATE: Zero.
STEPMOM (O.S.): Out.
NATE: What?
His stepmom leans into frame, swinging a trash bag.
STEPMOM: I gave you three days.
NATE: Wait, mom-
SCENE 3 — EXT. FRONT PORCH — LATE AFTERNOON
Nate stands among trash bags and suitcases on the porch; his stepmom in the doorway behind him.
STEPMOM: You made your choice.
The door shuts. Nate drops to his hands and knees, picking spilled printouts off the pavement; a pair of brown suede sneakers steps into frame.
FRIEND: Bro, what happened?
NATE: I got kicked out.
FRIEND: For what? How many did you buy?
NATE: Don't. It's not funny.
His friend starts filming him on his phone, laughing, as Nate hurls a fistful of printouts in a tantrum.
NATE: Bro, why are you recording?
FRIEND: Wait, that was actually funny.
FRIEND: No... yes. Let's make videos.
NATE: Now?
FRIEND: Especially now.
His friend leans into his phone camera, grinning; Nate hovers behind him, nervous.
FRIEND: Just do it.
NATE: This better work.
SCENE 4 — EXT. CURB — LATE AFTERNOON
Nate and his friend sit on the curb by the trash bags, watching the views climb on the friend's phone.
FRIEND: That's actually good.
FRIEND: I told you.
Nate checks his own phone.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, still flat and red
NATE: Nothing, nothing.
FRIEND: Maybe it's broken.
NATE: Nope... great.
Nate flops backwards off the curb.
NATE: Bro, nothing works.
FRIEND: Wait.
NATE: What?
FRIEND: Everybody trades these.
NATE: So?
FRIEND: They're saturated.
NATE: Oh.
NATE: Wait, so what do I trade?
His friend takes Nate's phone and scrolls through fresh tokens.
★ fomo screen: Home — on Nate's phone in his friend's hand, his thumb scrolling
FRIEND: Those are way better.
NATE: Like what?
FRIEND: Something people actually want.
FRIEND: Exactly.
FRIEND: Can you afford them?
NATE: Barely.
Nate's thumb hovers over Buy, then taps it; his friend leans in.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the first green candle
NATE: Bro, these better work.
FRIEND: Okay, that was clean.
NATE: Lock in.
SCENE 5 — MONTAGE — FRIEND'S GARAGE — NIGHTS
Nate, cap backwards, hunched over his phone on an upturned crate in his friend's garage at 2 a.m., face lit blue.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the position reads +$38 (+2.4%)
Nate rubs his eyes; the clock on the wall jumps to 4 a.m., cold pizza beside him.
A small win: Nate's tired eyes flicker, a tiny fist pump, the balance reads $1,240; straight back to the screen.
Another late night: rain on the garage window, his friend asleep on a beanbag, Nate still scrolling charts; the balance reads $4,700.
A bigger win: Nate and his friend lean over the phone as the balance reads $18,900 and grab each other's shoulders.
Nate checks his phone, turns to his friend, arms out.
NATE: Wait, we're out already?
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $512,400
Nate's red supercar tears down a city street at golden hour, Nate at the wheel, exhaust popping flames; pedestrians flinch, a passer-by looks up from his phone and his jaw drops.
SCENE 6 — INT. SUPERCAR / EXT. INTERSECTION — DUSK
Nate, cap backwards, glances back at the stunned sidewalk and laughs.
NATE: My bad.
NATE: Haha.
The supercar stops at a red light beside a beige sedan; a woman with long wavy hair stares across from the driver's seat.
WOMAN: Nate, is that you?
NATE: Yep.
WOMAN: Where do you even get those wins?
NATE: That's in my bio.
Nate winks.
WOMAN: Nate!
Nate bursts out laughing; snap zoom into his laughing mouth.
Nate turns to camera, holding up his phone.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone held to camera, the balance reads $512,400
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.

cast.description: Teen, slim; big glossy brown eyes, thick dark brows, dark curly hair; navy cap worn backwards, plain white tee, thin silver chain, black pants, white sneakers. Same look all the way to the supercar.
Early 40s, slim; long wavy auburn-brown hair, glasses pushed up on her head; white tank top, black shorts. Big shouting mouth, finger-jabbing.
Late teens, tall and lanky; swoopy brown hair, big nose; grey hoodie, black jeans, brown suede sneakers. Always has his phone out, quick to laugh.
Early 40s; long wavy auburn-brown hair, drawn like the stepmom; plain cream top, at the wheel of a beige sedan. Jaw-drop reactions.
